item.title: Utah Teens Who Helped Locate 11-year-old Killed in Avalanche Tell Story
item.description: An 11-year-old died in an avalanche earlier this month. Now, the teen skiers who found her have recounted their experience of attempting to save the girl.

item.title: All 9 Bodies of Castle Peak Avalanche Victims Have Been Recovered, Identified, Says Sheriff
item.description: The Nevada County Sheriff's Office says it has recovered the bodies of all nine victims who perished in the February 17 avalanche on Castle Peak.

item.title: This Irish Slab Got About As Good As It Gets, and These Surfers Scored
item.description: Ireland is not a place with swaying palms and blue skies. Powerful storms create powerful waves. Waves like Mullaghmore. And waves like Aileen's.

item.title: Queen of Corbet’s Piper Kunst on Expression, Competition, and the Future of Freeride Skiing
item.description: Piper Kunst spoke with us about her recent win at Corbet's Couloir in Jackson Hole and her journey as a freeride skier. It's been on helluva trip.

item.title: Kelly Slater Announces Second Child With Kalani Miller
item.description: Kelly Slater, 54, and longtime partner Kalani Miller, 38, announced the development via Instagram on Sunday

item.title: Leo Fioravanti on Why He Opposes the New Olympic Surfing Qualification System
item.description: Leo Fioravanti slammed the new 2028 Olympic qualification rules. He says cutting CT qualification spots hurts Olympic surfing.

item.title: Why ISA President Fernando Aguerre Thinks Olympic Surfing Qualification Changes Are Right Move
item.description: The ISA confirmed significant changes to the qualifying for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics, triggering reactions across the professional surfing world.

item.title: Endless Surf Announces Saltwater Wave Pool in Saudi Arabia
item.description: The ADRENA lagoon utilizes a closed-loop circulation system that draws seawater in, filters and circulates it through the lagoon, and returns it to the Red Sea.

item.title: Bomb Cyclone Hernando Whipped Up Massive Waves in New Jersey
item.description: Bomb Cyclone Hernando was a force of nature. It put hundreds of thousands in the dark, but also brought waves. Where you find waves, you often find Ben Gravy.

item.title: Two Hikers, 19 and 20, Found Dead in Welsh Mountain Range
item.description: The bodies of two hikers have been found in the Eryri mountain range, colloquially known as Snowdonia.
